# Gemini Omni Storyboard Approval Desk

Gemini Omni Storyboard Approval Desk is a SaaS workspace for Gemini Omni storyboard approval workflow.

Website: https://geminiomniapproval.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: Gemini Omni storyboard approval workflow
Type: SaaS
Default plan: team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
